title: Ethereum Foundation’s Privacy Team Rebrands as PSE, Unveils End-to-End Onchain Privacy Roadmap
summary: The Ethereum Foundation's Privacy & Scaling Explorations team rebranded as Privacy Stewards for Ethereum (PSE), unveiling an ambitious roadmap to make privacy the default rather than exception across Ethereum's technical stack through three core tracks including private writes, private reads, and private proving, following Vitalik Buterin's April advocacy for privacy as essential to Ethereum's survival as a global settlement infrastructure. The post Ethereum Foundation’s Privacy Team Rebrands as PSE, Unveils End-to-End Onchain Privacy Roadmap appeared first on Cryptonews .
